name: virtual-judge
description: Sandboxed online judge — a code execution engine with a judge as one client

scripts.test:engine: npm run build && npm run test -w @vj/engine
scripts.test:worker: npm run build && npm run test -w @vj/worker
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run test:lifecycle && npm run test:public-api && npm run test:public-api-limits
scripts.test:lifecycle: JWT_SECRET=integration-test-secret SIGNUP_RATE_MAX=1000 LOGIN_RATE_MAX=1000 SUBMISSION_RATE_MAX=5 SUBMISSION_RATE_WINDOW_MS=60000 TS_NODE_PROJECT=tests/tsconfig.json ts-node tests/integration/submission-lifecycle.ts
scripts.test:public-api: JWT_SECRET=integration-test-secret SIGNUP_RATE_MAX=1000 LOGIN_RATE_MAX=1000 MAX_ACTIVE_API_KEYS=2 API_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=100000 API_MAX_CONCURRENT_EXECUTIONS=50 TS_NODE_PROJECT=tests/tsconfig.json ts-node tests/integration/public-api.ts
scripts.test:public-api-limits: JWT_SECRET=integration-test-secret SIGNUP_RATE_MAX=1000 LOGIN_RATE_MAX=1000 API_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=5 API_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS=3000 API_MAX_CONCURRENT_EXECUTIONS=2 API_DAILY_EXECUTION_QUOTA=4 TS_NODE_PROJECT=tests/tsconfig.json ts-node tests/integration/public-api-limits.ts
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:engine && npm run test:worker && npm run test:integration
